overview: Standing, as you read everything, you had the book in your hands. Harrison found the leaf. In the margin, small, two words: Sweet Shakspeare. You read them, and the names above and below, and you read them again. What stood round the two words was too small to take.

parties.name: William Shakespeare
parties.context: Read the two words, and the names above and below, and the two words again.

parties.name: Richard Field
parties.context: Put the book in his hands, and kept a finger at the margin.

parties.name: John Harrison
parties.context: Found the leaf with a stubby thumb.
